facts.fact: The document is the text of Angola's Law no. 11/02 of 16 August 2002, the Law on Access to Administrative Documents (Lei de Acesso aos Documentos Administrativos), dated by its title to 16 August 2002.
facts.system: Lei n.º 11/02 - Lei de Acesso aos Documentos Administrativos (2002)

note: Presidential Decree 52/26 approves the state administration's inspection regulation (IGAE); it is not an access to information law or a regulation made under one, and art. 46 only lets the administered consult inspection files.
